answer_verbatim:
If you want **online courses for shadow work**, the strongest options in your results are **Jungian/psychology-oriented courses** and **guided self-inquiry programs** rather than fully clinical training.[2][5][15] For **spiritual practice**, the best fit is usually a course that combines shadow work with meditation, contemplation, or inner-awareness practices, such as Insight Timer’s shadow-work meditation course or Charlie Morley’s *Embracing the Shadow*.[10][15]

Here’s a practical shortlist from the results, organized by likely usefulness:

| Course | Best for | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work** | Learning the psychological foundations | A good starting point if you want a more structured Jung-based introduction.[2] |
| **Embracing The Shadow** | Shadow work with a spiritual/meditative angle | Taught by Charlie Morley and positioned as a shadow-work course with a contemplative approach.[15] |
| **Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self For Healing And Growth** | Guided beginner-friendly practice | Hosted on Insight Timer, which makes it especially accessible for meditation-oriented learners.[10] |
| **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** | Self-paced hands-on practice | Workbook-based format can be useful if you prefer exercises over lectures.[16] |
| **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** | Introductory, accessible self-study | A general Udemy option for beginners.[3] |
| **Do Your Own Shadow Work: Beginning to Advanced Practices** | Progressive self-study | Best if you want a broader practice path with more depth.[13] |
| **Shadow Mastery Course & Exercises** | Structured personal development | Appears to emphasize exercises and practical application.[5] |
| **Shadow Course: Discover Your Hidden Potential** | General personal/spiritual growth | More oriented toward self-development than academic psychology.[14] |

A few notes to help you choose:
- If you want the **most credible psychological foundation**, start with **Jung-platform’s Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work**.[2]
- If you want **spiritual practice plus shadow work**, **Charlie Morley’s course** and the **Insight Timer course** are the closest matches in your results.[10][15]
- If you want **something inexpensive and self-paced**, the **Udemy** courses are the most accessible options, though they vary in depth and quality.[3][7][11][13][16]
- If you want **facilitator or practitioner training**, the **Shadow Work Basic Facilitator Training Online** and the **Shadow Work Practitioner Online Certificate Course** are more formalized options.[8][9]

If you want, I can also turn this into a **top 3 recommendation list** based on your goal: **healing**, **spiritual growth**, or **professional facilitation**.
